dataset.selection_rule: fixed contiguous IDs 0081 through 0100 from official VAT test split
dataset.use: FINAL INDEPENDENT EVALUATION ONLY; never train or optimize
dataset.exclusions: 0001-0020 train; 0021-0025 crop development; 0051-0060 preprocessing development; 0061-0080 historical candidate; 0081-0100 final heldout

scope: IMAGE-LEVEL HOLDOUT ONLY. Audit found physical invoice identity overlap across upstream train/test images; NOT a strictly invoice-disjoint benchmark.

protocol.normalization: NFKC and removal of punctuation and whitespace on both sides, because the keyword annotations omit printed punctuation
protocol.spotting: keyword occurs in a predicted line covering >=80% of the GT rectangle
protocol.crop_recognition: GT crop CRNN+CTC component metric, separate from end-to-end spotting

limitations: Invoice numbers repeat across camera-training and image-holdout photographs. A separate identity-disjoint subset is required.
Small contiguous fixed subset, not a broad general invoice benchmark.
Upstream pretraining data is incompletely documented; upstream overlap cannot be ruled out.
Vertical text reported separately; the classic recognizer is horizontal.
No global precision/F1 because other invoice text is not annotated.
